description:
**About the company**

Experiences fueled by innovations, forward thinking, and a commitment to bring the very best to Indian roads. From the day the iconic Maruti 800 was launched in 1983, the company has been spearheading a revolution of change. Turning an entire country’s need for driving, into its love for driving. However, tastes and demands keep on evolving with each new generation of Indians. This has not been looked at by Maruti Suzuki as a challenge, but as an inspiration to go beyond traditional boundaries of car-making. Infusing design and technology is one such step it has taken to make its cars meet new age expectations smoothly.

Maruti Suzuki India Limited, BU Hansalpur plant is a subsidiary of Maruti Suzuki India Limited to produce automobiles from Gujarat, was established in March 2014, aiming to secure production ability in preparation for the automobile market growth in India, as well as for expansion of exports from India. In MSIL – BU Hansalpur, Plant A started operating from February 2017, subsequently Plant B, Powertrain Plant started in January 2019. In October 2020, MSIL-BU Hansalpur became the fastest production site of Maruti Suzuki to achieve accumulated automobile production of 1 million units. MSIL – Hansalpur is also home of Maruti Suzuki’s prestigious e-Vitara, the first EV of Maruti Suzuki in world. The plant proudly exported the e-Vitara to more than 165 countries so far. Today, Maruti Suzuki has its eyes set firmly on the possibilities of tomorrow.

**Designation: Manager/ Sr. Manager- Product Innovation & Fabric Expert**
**Location: Gandhinagar**
**About The Role**
To lead product innovation and fabric development initiatives for the Covers category by improving product aesthetics, functionality, durability, and customer experience through advanced fabric research, innovative stitching techniques, accessories development, and product engineering. The role will be responsible for repositioning the entire Covers portfolio by identifying best-in-class fabrics, optimizing product construction, and introducing innovative design features that enhance perceived value while maintaining cost competitiveness.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Product Design & Aesthetic Enhancement
* Review existing Covers portfolio and benchmark against global competitors.
* Develop innovative stitching patterns and construction methods to improve product appearance.
* Improve product fit, shape retention, and premium look.
* Introduce design elements that enhance customer perception and usability.
* Standardize product finishing specifications across categories.
* Improve packaging and presentation of finished products.
* Accessories & Trim Innovation
* Develop and evaluate accessories such as:
* Buckles
* Straps
* Drawcords
* Elastic systems
* Velcro closures
* Air vents
* Handles
* Reinforcement patches
* Branding elements
* Identify opportunities to improve functionality and aesthetics through trims and hardware.
* Fabric Research & Development
* Lead fabric innovation programs for all cover categories.
* Evaluate lighter-weight fabrics without compromising durability.
* Develop category-wise fabric strategy based on:
* Weather resistance
* UV resistance
* Water repellency
* Breathability
* Strength
* Cost
* Customer expectations
* Benchmark global fabric suppliers and technologies.
* Develop alternative fabric sourcing strategies to reduce cost and improve performance.
* Work with suppliers on new coating and finishing technologies.
* Product Engineering & Testing
* Define performance standards for each category.
* Conduct testing for:
* UV resistance
* Waterproofness
* Tear strength
* Abrasion resistance
* Color fastness
* Weathering performance
* Establish product validation protocols before commercialization.
* Create technical specifications and BOM standards.
* Competitive Benchmarking
* Benchmark leading brands in:
* Outdoor covers
* Furniture covers
* Grill covers
* Equipment covers
* Automotive covers
* Identify innovation trends and customer pain points.
* Recommend product upgrades based on market intelligence.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work closely with:
* Design Team
* Sourcing Team
* Manufacturing Team
* Quality Team
* Product Management Team
* Support pilot runs and commercialization of new products.
* Drive innovation projects from concept to production launch.

**Key Deliverables (First 12 Months)**
**Product Enhancement**

* Complete review of entire Covers portfolio.
* Develop category-wise premium product positioning strategy.
* Launch improved construction standards for all key categories.

**Fabric Development**
Identify and validate lighter-weight fabric alternatives.
  
  
Develop fabric matrix for each cover category.
  
  
Deliver minimum 3–5 new fabric innovations.
  
  
**Innovation Pipeline**
Launch minimum 10 product improvement initiatives.
  
  
Reduce product weight while maintaining performance standards.
  
  
Improve customer satisfaction related to fit, appearance, and functionality.
  
  
**Cost & Value Improvement**
Improve value perception without increasing product cost significantly.
  
  
Develop premium and value-engineered product tiers.

* B.Tech / B.E. Textile Technology

* Product Engineering

* Technical textiles
* Outdoor products
* Protective covers
* Furniture covers
* Automotive covers
* Home furnishing products
* Product development

**Technical Skills**

* Pattern development

* Cost engineering

title: Project Engineer–Commercial Solar Projects
description:
**Role Summary**

Ample Solar is looking for a Project Engineer to take ownership of the execution of commercial and industrial solar projects from post sales handover through planning, installation, testing, and commissioning.

The role involves close coordination with engineering, procurement, dispatch, installation, electrical and customer teams to ensure that projects are executed systematically, within the committed schedule, and as per the required quality standards.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Take ownership of end to end execution of commercial solar projects from sales handover to commissioning.
* Develop project execution schedules covering engineering, material readiness, dispatch, site installation, electrical works, testing and commissioning.
* Coordinate with Design, Liaisoning team, Procurement, Stores, Dispatch and Installation teams to ensure timely availability of resources and materials.
* Plan and coordinate deployment of installation teams based on project requirements and execution schedules.
* Monitor project progress against planned milestones and ensure timely completion of activities.
* Identify project constraints, site issues, and potential delays in advance and take appropriate corrective actions.
* Coordinate with customers, site representatives, vendors, and contractors for smooth project execution.
* Ensure execution is carried out in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, safety and quality requirements.
* Coordinate testing, commissioning, statutory/DISCOM activities wherever applicable, and final project handover.
* Maintain project status, execution records, and timely reporting to the management.

**Candidate Profile**

* 3–4 years of experience in Solar EPC/Project Execution, preferably handling commercial or industrial rooftop projects.
* Strong understanding of solar PV systems, electrical installation, and project execution.
* Experience in coordinating installation teams, contractors, vendors and multiple internal departments.
* Good knowledge of project planning, material coordination, and site execution.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and work towards strict project timelines.
* Strong communication, coordination, follow-up, and problem solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and project tracking/reporting tools will be an advantage.

**Key Requirement**

The ideal candidate should have a strong project ownership mindset, capable of planning the execution well in advance, coordinating all required resources and taking timely action to ensure that commercial solar projects are completed as committed, without avoidable delays.

**Compensation & Career Growth Opportunities:**

* The candidate will be offered a competitive cost to company (CTC) along with performance based incentives linked to the timely implementation of assigned projects and other governing parameters
* Company believes in company growth along with their employee growth, Strong opportunities for professional growth, career advancement, and long term leadership development.
* We rise together: your personal development fuels our corporate expansion in the solar industry.

**Company Overview:**

Ample Solar Private Limited is a Gujarat based solar company delivering scalable renewable energy solutions from rooftop systems, ground mounted solar projects to multi megawatt industrial solar projects. The company serves residential customers, MSMEs, and large industries with a strong focus on engineering quality and execution excellence.

With 3000+ operations completed and demonstrated capability in MW scale project execution, Ample Solar supports large industrial clients in achieving energy cost optimization and sustainability targets. Backed as an authorized Tata Group channel partner, the company brings good quality components, structured processes, and reliable delivery across all project sizes. Ample Solar is also entered a phase of strategic multi state expansion, strengthening its presence in key industrial corridors to support India’s clean energy transition.

title: Application Expert- Drives & Automation
description:
**Job Title** 
 : Assistant Manager/Manager
 



  





**Location** 
 : Sanand, Gujarat
 



  





**Company** 
 : Hitachi Hi\-Rel Power Electronics Private Limited
 



  





**Position Overview** 
 : As the Senior Application Expert (LV Drives), the candidate will be the technical backbone of our new LV business vertical. Reporting directly to the Channel Sales Head, this role's primary mandate is to create technical "pull" in the market by converting complex engineering specifications at the consultant, OEM, and end\-user levels. The candidate will bridge the gap between sales and technology—equipping our internal regional sales team and our channel partners (System Integrators and Distributors) with the application expertise needed to win high\-value, application\-specific business. The candidate will be coordinating with HIES/HINC for application code / software development if required to support local team to apply carry forward same OEMs in India.
 



  





**Department:** 
 Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Position Reporting to:** 
 Channel Sales Head\- Sales \& Marketing
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  





 Responsible for meeting the LV1 Module Technical Support:
 



 1\.Act as the subject matter expert (SME) for complex, heavy\-duty, and specialized LV VFD applications across industries (e.g., crane/hoist, tension control, multi\-drive systems, Compressors, Extruders, high\-speed pumps/fans, and HVAC systems, Machinery, Level 1 Automation).
 



 2\.Conduct joint technical visits with channel partners to key OEMs, Industrial End\-Users, and Automation Consultants to influence technical specifications in favour of our Japanese technology.
 



 3\.Analyze customer technical requirements, perform sizing, selection, and configuration of drives, and prepare robust, foolproof technical proposals. Troubleshoot complex application challenges during the pre\-sales phase to demonstrate product superiority and build customer confidence.
 



 4\.Design and deliver structured technical training programs, product certification courses, and application workshops for System Integrators (SIs), Value Added Resellers (VARs), and Distributors.
 



 5\.Create a self\-reliant channel ecosystem by empowering partner engineers to handle standard configurations and basic commissioning independently.
 



 6\.Provide continuous technical mentoring and application support to the internal team of 7–8 regional channel managers.
 



 7\.Perform deep technical benchmarking against key competitors (e.g., ABB, Siemens, Danfoss, Schneider, Fuji, Yaskawa Etc) to identify our product USPs and counter competitor arguments.
 



 8\.Develop localized application notes, success stories, and technical whitepapers to support the field sales team.
 



 Gather market intelligence on required product modifications, software features, or customized firmware, feeding this data back to the global Japanese R\&D and Product Management teams.
 



**Education Qualifications** 
 : B.E \- Electrical/ Instrumentation/ Electronics/EC/ Industrial Engg.
 



**Experience** 
 : Min. 10 years with min 6\-7 Yrs of strictly focus on LV Product Technical support across various industries
 



  





**Essential Knowledge \& skills:** 
 Experience of LV Drive Application knowledge in various fields, PLC programming, code writing, Good Presentation skills, Training ability
 



  





**Preferred Knowledge \& Skills:** 
 LV Drive market knowledge and product knowledge. Gujarati, Hindi and English language proficiency. Should be local resident, ready to travel across India.
